svg.aria-label: A roof reading one charter, drafted at the founding virtual meeting, rests on four working-group pillars, reference genomes and capacity, population genomics, applied conservation genomics, and data platform and open access, standing on a phasing slab from reference genomes to stock baselines to applied conservation, with a training and capacity side card
svg.title: One charter, four working groups
svg.text: One charter, three classes, four working groups
The three node classes are not three separate projects. They are three roles inside one charter, bound by
shared standards, shared data and shared training.
